name: Alfajor - Wikipedia
snippet: Traditional alfajores in Argentina, Peru, Uruguay and Venezuela consist of two round, sweet biscuits made of wheat flour or corn flour joined with dulce de leche (known as "manjar blanco" in Peru and as "arequipe" in Venezuela), and optionally coated with powdered sugar.
